It is built by `markdown.NewService()` with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`, called from `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. The interface is held by `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, and by `RSSService.MarkdownService` in `server/router/rss/rss.go`. `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` also holds it, though it may not be wired at server startup.

`RebuildMemoPayload` accepts the interface as a parameter and is invoked from `memo_service.go`. API handlers also use `MarkdownService`.

The Go backend interface is `markdown.Service`. Other markdown-related interfaces in the frontend are also being checked.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` accepts the interface as a parameter. `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called outside tests, so the backend interface is not held by a production runner.

memopayload.NewRunner is never called. RebuildMemoPayload is the only runtime function. It accepts a markdown.Service parameter.

**impl** — The only runtime concrete type is the unexported `*service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, which implements `markdown.Service` and is returned by `markdown.NewService()`. There are no other implementations in non-test code.

**construction** — A single instance is built in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`):

```47:51:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
func NewAPIV1Service(secret string, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) *APIV1Service {
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
```

That path is reached from `server.NewServer` (`server/server.go`), which calls `apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(...)`.

**holders** — Two components store the `markdown.Service` interface at runtime:

1. **`APIV1Service.MarkdownService`** — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (used by `memo_service.go`, `memo_mention_helpers.go`, and `memo_service_webhooks.go`; also passed into `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`).
2. **`RSSService.MarkdownService`** — `server/router/rss/rss.go`, wired in `server/server.go` with the same instance: `rss.NewRSSService(..., apiV1Service.MarkdownService)`.

`memopayload.Runner` also declares a `MarkdownService markdown.Service` field (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`), but `NewRunner` is not called anywhere in production code, so that holder is never populated at runtime.
